newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian economist denies cenbank appointment.
newsitem.headline: Colombian economist denies cenbank appointment.

text.p: Mauricio Cardenas, head of Colombia's prestigious economic think-tank Fedesarrollo, denied a published report that he had been asked to fill a vacancy on the policy-making board of directors of Colombia's central bank.
"It's not going to happen," said Cardenas, a highly-respected economist educated at the University of California at Berkeley who served as Development Minister under former president Cesar Gaviria.
"The probability of that event occurring is zero," he added.
